findings: The profile adapter needs independent natural/perceptual evidence whose candidate identity, current dist hash, actual screenshot/trace files and exact branch coverage are verified. The factory owner is handling pause/resume/wiring; this file-level verifier can be implemented independently.
instructions: You are not alone in the codebase. Do not revert other edits. Own only the new core helper and its tests; never edit factory.ts, schemas/profile-stage.ts, existing action-feel-stage.ts, or generated game workspaces.

Implement exported type ActionFeelCandidateIdentity {slot: A|B|C; workspace: string (absolute); targetRunId: string; targetGame: string; experimentId: string}. Export async verifyActionFeelPlayerEvidence(input: {runRoot:string; candidate:ActionFeelCandidateIdentity; naturalReport?:unknown; perceptualReport?:unknown; contract?:unknown}): Promise<{naturalPlay:ProfileIndependentEvidence; perceptual:ProfileIndependentEvidence}>. Export hashActionFeelCandidateBuild(workspace:string) for producer/test reproducibility.

Use existing ProfileIndependentEvidenceSchema for returned summaries, NaturalFlowEvidenceSchema for traces, ProductExperienceContractSchema and PerceptualQaReportSchema with verifyPerceptualQaReview for perceptual evidence. No weakened self-report schema.

Natural report wrapper must be Zod validated: schemaVersion 1, exact targetRunId/targetGame/targetWorkspace/experimentId/slot, current buildHash, trace {path,sha256}, screenshots [{path,sha256}] (at least two). The trace is a file parsed by NaturalFlowEvidenceSchema with matching buildHash, runtime web-lite, device present, reset, normal actions, terminal/settlement, replay, no forbiddenOperations and no fixture/deterministic runner. Validate actual bytes and file hashes. Trace screenshot paths must be covered by wrapper hashes. Run runVisualEvidenceGate to reject blank/unreadable captures. Missing data returns blocked summaries instead of throwing.

Compute current candidate dist hash with the same scheme as factory hashBuildDirectory: sorted relative regular-file paths mapped to file:sha256 joined by newline, sha256Text of that string. Require candidate.workspace to be a real non-symlink descendant of runRoot/workspace. Evidence files must remain inside run root and reject symlinks/path escapes.

For perceptual evidence require a valid candidate-bound contract and invoke verifyPerceptualQaReview({runRoot,workspace:candidate.workspace,contract,buildHash,report:perceptualReport}); additionally verify contract targetRunId/targetGame/workspace matches candidate. Missing contract/report stays blocked. Summaries include candidate identity/experimentId, verified flags, evidence paths and blockers.

Use test-first development: missing, wrong build, wrong workspace/run, missing screenshot, fixture trace, and stale bytes all fail closed. Include a fully bound positive fixture. Do not invoke providers. Run focused tests and typecheck; root runs final full suite.
acceptanceChecks: No missing/forged/stale/cross-candidate evidence can return passed.
Valid bound natural and independent perceptual fixture returns passed using existing verifiers.
The helper does not change any run/workspace files.
Owned tests pass and export signatures match the declared integration API.
